"""Test backward compatibility of the Dataset serialization fix."""

import numpy as np
import xarray as xr
import weldx

def test_backward_compatibility():
    """Test that datasets serialized before the fix can still be read."""
    print("Testing backward compatibility...")
    
    # Create a simple dataset without DataArray attributes (typical old case)
    ds = xr.Dataset({
        "temp": (["x", "y"], np.random.rand(3, 4)),
        "pressure": (["x", "y"], np.random.rand(3, 4))
    })
    ds.attrs = {"experiment": "test"}
    
    # Serialize it (this would create the old format without variable_attributes)
    ds_serialized = weldx.asdf.util.write_read_buffer({"ds": ds})
    ds_restored = ds_serialized["ds"]
    
    # Should work fine
    assert ds.identical(ds_restored)
    # variable_attributes field won't exist in old serialized data, 
    # but our code handles that gracefully
    print("✅ Backward compatibility maintained")

def test_mixed_scenarios():
    """Test that new datasets with attributes work alongside old ones."""
    print("Testing mixed scenarios...")
    
    # Old-style dataset (no DataArray attrs)
    ds_old = xr.Dataset({
        "data": (["time"], np.arange(10))
    })
    ds_old.attrs = {"version": "1.0"}
    
    # New-style dataset (with DataArray attrs)  
    da_new = xr.DataArray(np.arange(10), name="enhanced_data", attrs={"units": "meters", "accuracy": "high"})
    ds_new = da_new.to_dataset()
    ds_new.attrs = {"version": "2.0"}
    
    # Both should serialize/deserialize correctly
    ds_old_restored = weldx.asdf.util.write_read_buffer({"ds": ds_old})["ds"]
    ds_new_restored = weldx.asdf.util.write_read_buffer({"ds": ds_new})["ds"]
    
    # Old dataset should be identical
    assert ds_old.identical(ds_old_restored)
    
    # New dataset should preserve DataArray attributes
    assert ds_new.enhanced_data.attrs == ds_new_restored.enhanced_data.attrs == {"units": "meters", "accuracy": "high"}
    
    print("✅ Mixed scenarios work correctly")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_backward_compatibility()
    test_mixed_scenarios()
    print("All backward compatibility tests passed!")
